So you post on a shit hole like reddit and the mods kill your post. How do you understand what has happened and how do you even know it has happened.
Tag your posts with a really long password.
I for example use this type of format...
Cr5678#439-10M0qPmcvQ90#1!80
And change one letter per day and attach it to the end of my posts.

This means that I can go into a search and pull up my posts and see what kind of status they have.
I can log out or use incognito and then search that key to see where the mods have put my post.

Since I have been doing this I have had much less trouble with mods screwing my posts down.
